t.DIMETHICONE.agn: It is not in the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation; there is no specific limit or labelling rule. In food it appears as E900.
t.DIMETHICONE.eff.0: In the EU there is no health warning or usage limit specific to this substance. No substance-level scientific assessment has been read for this entry yet.
t.DIMETHICONE.what: Forms a thin film on skin and hair that makes them soft and smooth; reduces foaming.
